children: 21Shares Hyperliquid Staking ETF reported a net increase in net assets from operations of $13.5M for the period May 12, 2026–June 30, 2026, driven primarily by unrealized appreciation in the fund’s holdings; reported staking rewards contributing to net investment income totaled $125K for the period.
Net income: $13.5M net increase in net assets from operations for the period May 12, 2026–June 30, 2026.
Revenue: No traditional revenue/sales line item reported; net investment income comprised staking rewards of $125K for the period.
Diluted EPS: Not provided in the filing for the reporting period.
Launch & asset growth: The Trust commenced operations May 12, 2026. Shares outstanding expanded from 20,000 at launch to 1,880,000 by June 30, 2026, following 199 creations and 13 redemptions.
NAV & price performance: The ETF’s price (HYPE) rose 62.16% between May 12 and June 30, 2026, producing the $13.5M net increase in net assets largely from unrealized appreciation.
Staking operations: The Trust generally stakes 60–100% of HYPE (period average 91.7%); 94.43% of HYPE was staked at period end to capture staking rewards.
Rewards distribution & fees: Staking rewards are split with 30% allocated to the sponsor, staking providers, and custodians; the remainder is distributed to shareholders quarterly if earned.
Operational oversight & fees: The sponsor manages the Trust, earns a 0.30% NAV fee (paid in HYPE) and assumes routine operating expenses up to specified limits.
